t: A free voxel 3D modeling app that runs in a browser or on a desktop.
steps: Find the Voxel Builder project by nimadez on GitHub.
Open the hosted web version in Chrome or Firefox.
Install the Electron app on computers that need an offline copy.
Place a few voxels and paint them.
Save a model as a JSON file.
Export a model to STL for a 3D printer.
Test the tool on a Chromebook before planning a lesson.
